   101	\section{Parseval and the sandwich defect}
   102	
   103	Fix $x,z$ and one placement, suppressing these indices for the moment.
   104	For the trace character $\chi(u)=(-1)^{\tr(u)}$, the expanded observables
   105	$U_X^r,U_Z^s$ give the Fourier expressions
   106	$X_a=q^{-1}\sum_r\chi(ar)U_X^r$ and
   107	$Z_b=q^{-1}\sum_s\chi(bs)U_Z^s$.
   108	With $[T,U]=TU-UT$, character orthogonality therefore gives
   109	\[
   110	 \sum_{a,b}\|[X_a,Z_b]\hat\psi\|^2
   111	   =\frac1{q^2}\sum_{r,s}\|[U_X^r,U_Z^s]\hat\psi\|^2.
   112	\]
   113	Indeed, the coefficient matrix with rows $(a,b)$ and columns $(r,s)$ is
   114	$c_{(a,b),(r,s)}=\chi(ar)\chi(bs)$, and its columns satisfy
   115	\[
   116	 \sum_{a,b}\overline{c_{(a,b),(r,s)}}c_{(a,b),(r',s')}
   117	   =q^2\mathbf{1}_{(r,s)=(r',s')}.
   118	\]
   119	Expanding the squared norms as inner products cancels all unequal column
   120	indices.  The squared Fourier prefactor $q^{-4}$ leaves $q^{-2}$, precisely
   121	the uniform average above.  Thus the expanded-observable commutation bound
   122	underlying the source's binary-refinement estimate yields a field-valued
   123	bound $O(\sqrt\eps)$, with no dependence on $q$.\footnote{The Fourier
   124	definition is at lines~384--418 of the source; the commutation estimate is
   125	in \path{lem:qld-comm-cons}, lines~466--505.  The formal identities are
   126	\path{sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal} and
   127	\path{ProjectiveSetting.sum_norm_place_expPointOp_commutator_sq};
   128	\path{ProjectiveSetting.expPoint_comm} derives the bound in
   129	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Commutation.lean}.}
   130	
   131	Define the field-valued sandwich by $R_{a,b}=Z_bX_aZ_b$.
   132	It is positive, since $R_{a,b}=(X_aZ_b)^\dagger(X_aZ_b)$, and its effects
   133	sum to the identity by projectivity and completeness.  Moreover,
   134	$R_{a,b}-Z_bX_a=Z_b[X_a,Z_b]$.  Since $Z_b$ is a contraction, the same
   135	commutation bound controls $d^2(R,ZX)$.
   136	
   137	Next fix opposite placements $1,2$.  Operators on distinct placements
   138	commute, even when the players' local spaces differ.  Put
   139	$W_b=Z_{1,b}Z_{2,b}$, $D_a=X_{1,a}-X_{2,a}$, and
   140	$K_{j,a,b}=[X_{j,a},Z_{j,b}]$.  Define the nonnegative scalar errors
   141	\[
   142	 \begin{aligned}
   143	 e_X&=\sum_a\|D_a\hat\psi\|^2,&
   144	 e_Z&=\sum_b\|(Z_{1,b}-Z_{2,b})\hat\psi\|^2,\\
   145	 k_j&=\sum_{a,b}\|K_{j,a,b}\hat\psi\|^2.&
   146	 \end{aligned}
   147	\]
   148	For any two complete projective measurements $P,Q$ and any vector $w$,
   149	expanding the square gives
   150	\[
   151	 \sum_c\operatorname{Re}\langle w,P_cQ_cw\rangle
   152	   =\|w\|^2-\tfrac12\sum_c\|(P_c-Q_c)w\|^2.
   153	\]
   154	Cross-placement commutation gives
   155	$R_{1,a,b}R_{2,a,b}=W_b^\dagger X_{1,a}X_{2,a}W_b$.
   156	Applying the preceding identity first to the $X$ measurements in $W_b\hat\psi$
   157	and then to the $Z$ measurements in $\hat\psi$ proves the exact defect formula
   158	\[
   159	 1-\sum_{a,b}\langle\hat\psi,R_{1,a,b}R_{2,a,b}\hat\psi\rangle
   160	   =\tfrac12 e_Z+\tfrac12\sum_{a,b}\|D_aW_b\hat\psi\|^2.
   161	\]
   162	The overlap is real because the two placed sandwich effects commute.
   163	To bound the last sum, use the algebraic identity
   164	\[
   165	 D_aW_b=W_bD_a+Z_{2,b}K_{1,a,b}-Z_{1,b}K_{2,a,b}.
   166	\]
   167	The squared norm of a sum of three vectors is at most three times the sum
   168	of their squared norms.  Projector contraction and
   169	$\sum_b\|W_bv\|^2\leq\sum_b\|Z_{2,b}v\|^2=\|v\|^2$ then bound the defect by
   170	$c_{x,z}=\tfrac12 e_Z+\tfrac32(e_X+k_1+k_2)$.
   171	Self-consistency of the point measurements gives
   172	$\E e_X,\E e_Z=O(\eps)$; Parseval gives $\E k_j=O(\sqrt\eps)$.
   173	Consequently $\E c_{x,z}\leq C(\eps+\sqrt\eps)$ for a universal $C$.\footnote{
   174	The exact identity and estimate are \path{sandwich_overlap_identity} and
   175	\path{sandwich_defect_pointwise_le} in
   176	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Consistency.lean}.
   177	They replace the cited Cauchy--Schwarz chain, not its conclusion.}
   178	
   179	\section{Rounding and register transfer}
   180	
   181	The orthonormalization lemma for two consistent bipartite POVMs returns a
   182	projective measurement on the same local space as the first POVM.
   183	Its explicit version bounds squared distance to that POVM by $220c^{1/4}$
   184	when the consistency defect is at most $c$.  Apply it to the two sandwiches
   185	for each $(x,z)$, separately for Alice and Bob.  Concavity of the fourth root
   186	gives an averaged squared distance at most
   187	$220(\E c_{x,z})^{1/4}$.\footnote{This uses
   188	\path{projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant} in
   189	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems/ProjectiveRounding.lean}, the
   190	explicit form of \path{lem:ortho}.  The fiberwise application and averaging
   191	are in \path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Orthonormalization.lean}.}
   192	
   193	The involution $\tau=(A'\ B'')(A''\ B')$ fixes $A,B$ and preserves
   194	$\hat\psi$: it exchanges the two identical EPR pairs and reverses each pair.
   195	It carries $AA'$ to $AB''$ and $BA''$ to $BB'$, so the same locally chosen
   196	measurements have the same rounding errors on the second placement scheme.
   197	No symmetry of the original strategy is needed.  This is not the blueprint's
   198	permutation product $\sigma\theta$: that product sends $B'$ to $A'$, whereas
   199	$\tau$ sends $B'$ to $A''$.\footnote{Compare
   200	\path{lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer} in
   201	\path{blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex} with
   202	\path{ProjectiveSetting.eprCrossSwap} in
   203	\path{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Placement.lean}.}
   204	
   205	For each directed opposite pair, transport the projective factors one at a
   206	time to obtain $d^2((ZX)_p,(XZ)_{p'})=O(\eps)$.
   207	Combining this estimate with rounding, $d^2(R,ZX)=O(\sqrt\eps)$,
   208	and commutation proves all three target inequalities by the squared-distance
   209	triangle bound.  For $0\leq\eps\leq1$, their errors are bounded by
   210	$K\eps^{1/8}$.  For $\eps>1$, all the operator families involved satisfy
   211	$\sum_{a,b}F_{a,b}^\dagger F_{a,b}\leq I$, so their squared distances on a
   212	unit state are at most $4$; enlarging $K$ covers this case as well.
   213	
   214	\section{Conclusion}
   215	
   216	The blueprint retains the source's combined-point statement and its
   217	binary-refinement proof.  The formal construction proves that statement by
   218	the direct argument above, with both ordered products, all directed opposite
   219	placements, and the original expanded local spaces.\footnote{The blueprint
   220	entry is \path{lem:qld-4-10} in
   221	\path{blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex}; its construction theorem
   222	is \leanid{MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists\_combinedPointsWitness}.}
   223	There is no discrepancy in the combined-point conclusion under the existing
   224	parameter and polynomial-error conventions, and no additional construction
   225	is assumed.  The finite common-extension problem for the quoted quantum
   226	linearity theorem remains a separate open formalization task; this proof
   227	neither uses nor resolves it.

   141	    calc x = Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq hx.le).symm

   144	/-- Formalization-only absorption step for the low-degree soundness
   145	transport.  A bipartite consistency defect on a unit state that is at most
   146	`C₀` times the square root of the transport argument
   147	
   148	  `mainFormalError (2560000 m³ d) (3 ε) + m d / q + ε`

   150	whenever both `ε` and that argument are at most one is bounded by `deltaLd`

   153	Outside that regime the conclusion is vacuous quantitatively: the defect is

   157	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:139-167`, paper
   158	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`. -/
   159	theorem consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound
   160	    {a b C₀ : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) (hC₀ : 1 ≤ C₀)
   161	    (habs : ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
   162	      C₀ * (D.k : ℝ) *
   163	          Real.sqrt
   164	            (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   165	              ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) ≤
   166	        deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k)
   167	    (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
   168	    {X α ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   169	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   170	    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
   171	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α ιA) (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α ιB)
   172	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   173	    (hbound : ε ≤ 1 →
   174	      Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   175	            ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε ≤ 1 →
   176	        consistencyDefect μ (fun x c => heteroKron ((A x).effect c) 1)

   178	          C₀ *
   179	            Real.sqrt
   180	              (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +

   188	  rcases le_or_gt ε 1 with hε1 | hε1
   189	  · have hk : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (D.k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.hk

   191	        Real.sqrt
   192	          (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   193	            ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
   194	    have hstep : consistencyDefect μ (fun x c => heteroKron ((A x).effect c) 1)

   196	        C₀ *
   197	          Real.sqrt
   198	            (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   199	              ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) := by

   201	          (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   202	            ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) 1 with hT1 | hT1
   203	      · exact hbound hε1 hT1
   204	      · have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤
   205	            Real.sqrt
   206	              (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   207	                ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) := by
   208	          calc (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 := Real.sqrt_one.symm
   209	            _ ≤ _ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hT1.le
   210	        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hC₀) (sub_nonneg.mpr hone)]

   212	          (fun x c => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect c)) ψ
   213	        ≤ C₀ *
   214	            Real.sqrt
   215	              (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   216	                ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) := hstep
   217	      _ ≤ C₀ * (D.k : ℝ) *
   218	            Real.sqrt
   219	              (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   220	                ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) :=
   221	          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
   222	            (le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hk) hsqrtnn
   223	      _ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k := habs D ε hε hε1
   224	  · have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k :=
   225	      one_le_deltaLd_of_one_le_error ha hb.le hε1.le D.hm D.hd D.hk
   226	    linarith
   227	
   228	/-- Quantum soundness of the directly indexed low-degree game for simultaneity
   229	parameter `1`: the conclusions of `exists_direct_ld_soundness`, with universal
   230	constants of the same shape, under the hypothesis `D.k = 1`.
   231	
   232	The proof reads the coordinate conclusions of the low individual degree
   233	theorem as one-coordinate tuples
   234	(`exists_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements_of_k_eq_one`) and absorbs
   235	the resulting error bound into `deltaLd` by
   236	`exists_directLdTransportConstants` at the constant `C₀ = 1`, no sandwich
   237	being formed when there is one coordinate.  This is the case instantiated by
   238	the Chapter 15 combining argument at paper
   239	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1288`;
   240	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex` records why arbitrary
   241	`D.k` needs the combining reduction instead.  Blueprint
   242	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:139-167`, paper
   243	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`. -/
   244	theorem exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one :
   245	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   246	      ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), D.k = 1 → 0 < ε →
   247	        ∀ S : Strategy (directLdGame D), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   248	          ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
   249	            ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
   250	              consistencyDefect
   251	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   252	                  (fun u outcome =>
   253	                    heteroKron
   254	                      (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   255	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   256	                  (fun u outcome =>
   257	                    heteroKron 1
   258	                      ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   259	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
   260	              consistencyDefect
   261	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   262	                  (fun u outcome =>
   263	                    heteroKron
   264	                      ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
   265	                  (fun u outcome =>
   266	                    heteroKron 1
   267	                      (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   268	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
   269	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
   270	              consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   271	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
   272	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
   273	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k := by
   274	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, habs⟩ := exists_directLdTransportConstants 1 le_rfl
   275	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   276	  intro D ε hk hε S hS hwin
   277	  obtain ⟨GA, GB, h1, h2, h3⟩ :=
   278	    exists_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements_of_k_eq_one D hk S hS ε hwin
   279	  have hmd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) := by positivity
   280	  have hmature : ∀ hT :
   281	      Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   282	          ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε ≤ 1,
   283	      Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) ≤
   284	        Real.sqrt
   285	          (Test.mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 * ε) +
   286	            ((D.m : ℝ) * (D.d : ℝ)) / (D.q : ℝ) + ε) := by
   287	    intro hT
   288	    exact le_sqrt_of_le_of_le_one (by linarith) hT
   289	  refine ⟨GA, GB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   290	  · refine consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound ha hb le_rfl habs D ε hε
   291	      (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   292	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   293	      (fun u => (S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   294	        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D))
   295	      (fun u => GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)) S.ψ S.ψ_norm ?_
   296	    intro _ hT
   297	    rw [one_mul]
   298	    exact le_trans h1 (hmature hT)
   299	  · refine consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound ha hb le_rfl habs D ε hε
   300	      (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   301	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   302	      (fun u => GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u))
   303	      (fun u => (S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   304	        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)) S.ψ S.ψ_norm ?_
   305	    intro _ hT
   306	    rw [one_mul]
   307	    exact le_trans h2 (hmature hT)
   308	  · refine consistencyDefect_le_deltaLd_of_transportBound ha hb le_rfl habs D ε hε
   309	      (uniformDistribution Unit) (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   310	      (fun _ => GA) (fun _ => GB) S.ψ S.ψ_norm ?_
   311	    intro _ hT
   312	    rw [one_mul]
   313	    exact le_trans h3 (hmature hT)

   315	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Direct low-degree soundness for arbitrary strategies
     6	
     7	This module transports directly indexed low-degree soundness at simultaneity
     8	parameter `1` from projective strategies to arbitrary strategies. Both local
     9	measurement families are dilated by the existing one-measurement Naimark
    10	construction. The polynomial-tuple POVMs returned by projective soundness are
    11	then compressed to the original player carriers at the distinguished ancillary
    12	coordinate.
    13	
    14	Ground-slice compression preserves all three consistency defects exactly, so
    15	the error function and its universal constants are unchanged. The compressed
    16	polynomial POVMs are not asserted to be projective.
    17	
    18	## Main result
    19	
    20	* `exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one_any_strategy` removes the projectivity
    21	  premise from the formalization-only direct `k = 1` soundness route.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	The projective soundness input formalizes the shape of paper
    26	`lem:ld-soundness`,
    27	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`.
    28	The Naimark transport supports the first paragraph of the proof of paper
    29	`lem:qld-4-7`,
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1277-1289`.
    31	This module is Lean-only support and does not claim completion of that lemma.
    32	-/
    33	
    34	open scoped BigOperators
    35	
    36	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    37	
    38	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    39	open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    40	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    41	
    42	noncomputable section
    43	
    44	/-- Dilate every direct-game question measurement and pad the bipartite state
    45	at the two distinguished `none` coordinates. -/
    46	private def directLdNaimarkStrategy (D : DirectLdParams)
    47	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : Strategy (directLdGame D) :=
    48	  paddedStrategy S (none : Option (DirectLdAnswer D))
    49	    (none : Option (DirectLdAnswer D))
    50	    (fun question => dilatedMeasurement (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.A question))
    51	    (fun question => dilatedMeasurement (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.B question))
    52	
    53	/-- Every local measurement of the dilated direct-game strategy is projective. -/
    54	private theorem directLdNaimarkStrategy_isProjective (D : DirectLdParams)
    55	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : (directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).IsProjective :=
    56	  paddedStrategy_isProjective S none none _ _
    57	    (fun question => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective
    58	      (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.A question))
    59	    (fun question => dilatedMeasurement_isProjective
    60	      (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.B question))
    61	
    62	/-- The direct-game value is unchanged by the two local Naimark dilations. -/
    63	private theorem directLdNaimarkStrategy_value (D : DirectLdParams)
    64	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : (directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).value = S.value :=
    65	  paddedStrategy_value S none none _ _
    66	    (fun question answer => dilatedMeasurement_compression
    67	      (default : DirectLdAnswer D) answer (S.A question))
    68	    (fun question answer => dilatedMeasurement_compression
    69	      (default : DirectLdAnswer D) answer (S.B question))
    70	
    71	/-- Compressing Alice's dilated point measurement after point-answer
    72	postprocessing recovers the original postprocessed point measurement. -/
    73	private theorem directLdNaimarkStrategy_pointA_compress (D : DirectLdParams)
    74	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (question : DirectLdQuestion D) :
    75	    (((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A question).postprocess
    76	        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none =
    77	      (S.A question).postprocess (directLdPointValuesOrZero D) := by
    78	  change ((dilatedMeasurement (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.A question)).postprocess
    79	      (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none = _
    80	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.compressAt_postprocess,
    81	    Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement]
    82	  rfl
    83	
    84	/-- Compressing Bob's dilated point measurement after point-answer
    85	postprocessing recovers the original postprocessed point measurement. -/
    86	private theorem directLdNaimarkStrategy_pointB_compress (D : DirectLdParams)
    87	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (question : DirectLdQuestion D) :
    88	    (((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).B question).postprocess
    89	        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none =
    90	      (S.B question).postprocess (directLdPointValuesOrZero D) := by
    91	  change ((dilatedMeasurement (default : DirectLdAnswer D) (S.B question)).postprocess
    92	      (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none = _
    93	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.compressAt_postprocess,
    94	    Measurement.compressAt_dilatedMeasurement]

    97	/-- Formalization-only soundness transport for the directly indexed low-degree
    98	game at simultaneity parameter `1`, with no projectivity premise on the input
    99	strategy.
   100	
   101	Apply Naimark dilation to both question-indexed POVM families, use
   102	`exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one` on the resulting projective strategy,
   103	and compress its two polynomial-tuple POVMs at the distinguished ancillary
   104	coordinates. The padded-state defect identity preserves the two point versus
   105	polynomial bounds and the polynomial self-consistency bound exactly, with the
   106	same witnesses `a`, `b`, and `deltaLd` as the projective theorem.
   107	
   108	This theorem is Lean-only support for the Naimark step in the proof of paper
   109	`lem:qld-4-7`,
   110	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1277-1289`.
   111	It does not assert projectivity of the compressed POVMs and introduces no
   112	premise for a paper-labelled QPBT producer. -/
   113	theorem exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one_any_strategy :
   114	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   115	      ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), D.k = 1 → 0 < ε →
   116	        ∀ S : Strategy (directLdGame D), 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   117	          ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
   118	            ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
   119	              consistencyDefect
   120	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   121	                  (fun u outcome =>
   122	                    heteroKron
   123	                      (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   124	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   125	                  (fun u outcome =>
   126	                    heteroKron 1
   127	                      ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   128	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
   129	              consistencyDefect
   130	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   131	                  (fun u outcome =>
   132	                    heteroKron
   133	                      ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
   134	                  (fun u outcome =>
   135	                    heteroKron 1
   136	                      (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   137	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
   138	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
   139	              consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   140	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
   141	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
   142	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k := by
   143	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, hsound⟩ := exists_direct_ld_soundness_of_k_eq_one
   144	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hb1, ?_⟩
   145	  intro D ε hk hε S hwin
   146	  have hwin' : 1 - ε ≤ (directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).value := by
   147	    rw [directLdNaimarkStrategy_value]
   148	    exact hwin
   149	  obtain ⟨GA, GB, h1, h2, h3⟩ :=
   150	    hsound D ε hk hε (directLdNaimarkStrategy D S)
   151	      (directLdNaimarkStrategy_isProjective D S) hwin'
   152	  let GA0 : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA :=
   153	    GA.compressAt (none : Option (directLdGame D).AnswerA)
   154	  let GB0 : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB :=
   155	    GB.compressAt (none : Option (directLdGame D).AnswerB)
   156	  refine ⟨GA0, GB0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   157	  · have htransport :
   158	        consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   159	            (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   160	              ((((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A
   161	                (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   162	                  (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   163	            (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
   164	              ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   165	            (directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).ψ =
   166	          consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   167	            (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   168	              (((((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A
   169	                (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   170	                  (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none).effect outcome) 1)
   171	            (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
   172	              (((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).compressAt none).effect outcome))
   173	            S.ψ := by
   174	      change consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   175	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   176	            ((((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A
   177	              (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   178	                (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   179	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
   180	            ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   181	          (padState none none S.ψ) = _
   182	      exact consistencyDefect_padState_compressAt _ _ _ none none S.ψ
   183	    calc
   184	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   185	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   186	            (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   187	              (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   188	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
   189	            ((GB0.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome)) S.ψ =
   190	        consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   191	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   192	            (((((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A
   193	              (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   194	                (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).compressAt none).effect outcome) 1)
   195	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
   196	            (((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).compressAt none).effect outcome))
   197	          S.ψ := by
   198	            apply consistencyDefect_congr
   199	            · intro u outcome
   200	              rw [directLdNaimarkStrategy_pointA_compress]
   201	            · intro u outcome
   202	              dsimp only [GB0]
   203	              congr 1
   204	              ext i j
   205	              simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.compressAt_effect,
   206	                MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   207	                Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
   208	              rfl
   209	      _ = consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   210	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron
   211	            ((((directLdNaimarkStrategy D S).A
   212	              (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
   213	                (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
   214	          (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1

    19	\section{At a glance}
    20	
    21	\begin{itemize}
    22	  \item \textbf{Difficulty.} Easy for simultaneity parameter $k = 1$, hard
    23	  for general $k$.  The coordinatewise route planned for the formalization
    24	  applies the single-polynomial soundness theorem to each coordinate and
    25	  combines the resulting measurements by the sandwich of the source's
    26	  Lemma~\texttt{lem:ld-sandwich}; an explicit pair of measurements refutes
    27	  every bound this route could produce.  The source instead cites a
    28	  reduction of the $k$-tuple test to the single-polynomial test in $m + k$
    29	  variables at degree $d + 1$; that reduction is now carried out in the
    30	  formalization, in the individual-degree formulation, where the degree stays
    31	  $d$.
    32	  \item \textbf{Estimated weight.} The case $k = 1$ is closed by relabeling
    33	  the coordinate conclusions (about 150 lines).  The combining reduction is
    34	  complete: a combined strategy for the directly indexed game in dimension
    35	  $m + k$ at degree $d$, a transfer of the success probability with the
    36	  constant $10$, and the extraction of $k$ polynomials from one polynomial by
    37	  linearity, in about a dozen new definitions and 6000 lines of formal proof.
    38	  \item \textbf{Mathlib/project split.} The counterexample is finite Fourier
    39	  analysis over $\F_{2^s}$ and a Gram-matrix estimate.  The reduction itself
    40	  is almost entirely project-local (game constructions and the consistency
    41	  calculus), with the Schwartz--Zippel lemma and multivariate polynomial
    42	  algebra taken from Mathlib.

    44	  and isotropic vectors of a symmetric pairing in characteristic two; the
    45	  eigenvalue bound for nearly orthogonal unit vectors; the reduction proving
    46	  Theorem~4.43 from Theorem~4.40 in \cite{Natarajan2018NEEXP}.  Tracked in
    47	  \ghissue{134}.
    48	\end{itemize}

    50	\section{Key theorem forms}
    51	
    52	The source theorem (\texttt{lem:ld-soundness}) states that for every
    53	projective strategy passing the low individual degree game with parameters
    54	$(q,m,d,k)$ with probability at least $1 - \eps$ there are polynomial-tuple
    55	measurements $G^{\mathrm A}$ and $G^{\mathrm B}$, with outcomes
    56	$(g_1,\dots,g_k)$ of individual degree at most $d$, such that on average over
    57	a uniform point $u \in \F_q^m$
    58	\[
    59	  A^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{a} \ot I \simeq_{\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}}
    60	    I \ot G^{\mathrm B}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = a]},
    61	  \qquad
    62	  G^{\mathrm A}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = a]} \ot I \simeq_{\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}}
    63	    I \ot B^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{a},
    64	  \qquad
    65	  G^{\mathrm A}_{g} \ot I \simeq_{\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}} I \ot G^{\mathrm B}_{g},
    66	  \tag{source form}
    67	\]
    68	where $a = (a_1,\dots,a_k)$ and
    69	$\mathrm{eval}_u(g_1,\dots,g_k) = (g_1(u),\dots,g_k(u))$.
    70	
    71	The formalization planned to derive this from the case $k = 1$ as follows.
    72	Reading the $i$-th coordinate of every answer yields $k$ strategies for the
    73	game with $k = 1$, each passing with probability at least $1 - 3\eps$; the
    74	single-polynomial theorem gives projective measurements $G^{w,i}$ with
    75	\[
    76	  A^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{[a_i]} \ot I \simeq_{\delta}
    77	    I \ot G^{\mathrm B,i}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = a_i]},
    78	  \qquad
    79	  G^{\mathrm A,i}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = a_i]} \ot I \simeq_{\delta}
    80	    I \ot B^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{[a_i]},
    81	  \qquad
    82	  G^{\mathrm A,i}_{g} \ot I \simeq_{\delta} I \ot G^{\mathrm B,i}_{g},
    83	  \tag{coordinate form}
    84	\]
    85	where $A^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{[a_i]}$ is the $i$-th marginal of the joint
    86	point measurement; and the planned combination was the sandwich
    87	\[
    88	  C^{w}_{g_1,\dots,g_k}
    89	    = G^{w,k}_{g_k} \cdots G^{w,2}_{g_2}\, G^{w,1}_{g_1}\,
    90	      G^{w,2}_{g_2} \cdots G^{w,k}_{g_k},
    91	  \qquad
    92	  A^{\mathsf{Point},u}_{a} \ot I \simeq_{C k (\delta + md/q)^{1/2}}
    93	    I \ot C^{\mathrm B}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = a]},
    94	  \tag{planned form}
    95	\]
    96	with a universal constant $C$, and likewise on the other side and for the
    97	global relation.  We show that no statement of the planned form holds: the
    98	coordinate form, even with $\delta = 0$ and even with both point
    99	measurements and all $2k$ polynomial measurements available, does not
   100	determine any polynomial-tuple measurement consistent with the joint point
   101	measurement.
   102	
   103	The formalization proves the source form for every $k$, for the directly
   104	indexed low-degree game of \cite{gap:qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility} and by the
   105	source reduction rather than by the refuted route.  From a projective strategy for the
   106	directly indexed low-degree game with parameters $(q,m,d,k)$ succeeding with
   107	probability at least $1 - \eps$ it produces polynomial-tuple measurements
   108	satisfying the three relations of the source form with the error of the low
   109	individual degree theorem at the combined parameters $(q, m+k, d, 1)$, at the
   110	auxiliary parameter $2560000\,(m+k)^{3}d$ and pass bound $30\eps$, increased by
   111	the recovery loss $(m+k)d/q$ on the two point/polynomial relations;%
   112	\footnote{The declaration is
   113	\leanid{exists\_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements\_combinedError} in
   114	\doclink{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining/SimultaneousGeneral.lean}.}
   115	and, absorbing that error, the same three relations with the error function
   116	$\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}(\eps,q,m,d,k)$ of the source statement at the universal
   117	constants $a = 10^{23}$ and $b = 1/80000$.%
   118	\footnote{The declaration is \leanid{exists\_direct\_ld\_soundness} in
   119	\doclink{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Soundness.lean}.  The case
   120	$k = 1$, the only one instantiated by the Pauli basis test analysis, remains
   121	available separately as
   122	\leanid{exists\_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements\_of\_k\_eq\_one}
   123	in \doclink{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Simultaneous.lean};
   124	its form with the error function $\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}$ is
   125	\leanid{exists\_direct\_ld\_soundness\_of\_k\_eq\_one} in
   126	\doclink{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/Soundness.lean}, and the
   127	source-shaped seed-indexed form is
   128	\leanid{exists\_ld\_soundness\_of\_k\_eq\_one} in
   129	\doclink{MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/DirectLowDegree/SeedIndexedSoundness.lean};
   130	the instantiation with $k = 1$ at dimension $2m+2$ is in the proof of
   131	\texttt{lem:qld-4-7}, \path{blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex}.}
   132	
   133	The route is the source's: the combined strategy answers each question of the
   134	game at the combined parameters by measuring one question of the original
   135	strategy and relabeling its outcome, its success probability is at least
   136	$1 - 10\eps$, the case $k = 1$ is applied once to it, and the $k$ polynomials
   137	are recovered from the single outcome polynomial by exact linearity in the
   138	fresh coordinates.  Two quantitative points differ from the account of the
   139	source assertion below, and both are forced by the individual-degree
   140	formulation of the game.  The degree does not rise to $d + 1$: the combined
   141	polynomial $(u,\alpha) \mapsto \sum_r \alpha_r g_r(u)$ has individual degree
   142	at most $d$ in each of the $m + k$ variables, so the theorem is applied at
   143	degree $d$ and its error function is evaluated there.  Correspondingly the
   144	recovery cost is not $(d+1)/q$ taken twice but $(m+k)d/q$: the exact-linearity
   145	test on the point space contributes $md/q$, and the collision of two distinct
   146	tuples at the sampled point contributes $kd/q$.  A reader comparing the two
   147	accounts should read the displayed recovery term of the source assertion as
   148	$(m+k)d/q$ throughout.

   150	\section{The source assertion}
   151	
   152	The proof of \texttt{lem:ld-soundness} in
   153	\cite[lines~413--458]{Ji2020MIPStar} treats $k = 1$ by an identification
   154	with the tensor-code test of \cite{Ji2021Quantum} (the identification is
   155	examined in \path{docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex}) and
   156	then extends to general $k$ by reference to the derivation of Theorem~4.43
   157	from Theorem~4.40 in \cite[lines~1409--1503]{Natarajan2018NEEXP}.  That
   158	derivation is not coordinatewise.  It builds two combined provers who play
   159	the single-polynomial test in $m + k$ variables at degree $d + 1$: on a
   160	point $(\alpha, u)$ the combined prover asks the original prover for the $k$
   161	values $(b_1,\dots,b_k)$ at $u$ and returns $\sum_i \alpha_i b_i$, and on a
   162	line it returns the corresponding combination of the $k$ answer polynomials.
   163	The degree rises by one because the combination
   164	$(\alpha, u) \mapsto \sum_i \alpha_i g_i(u)$ is linear in $\alpha$ and of
   165	degree $d$ in $u$, so its restriction to a queried subspace has degree
   166	$d + 1$; the single-polynomial theorem is therefore applied at degree $d + 1$
   167	and its error function is evaluated there.  That theorem then yields one
   168	measurement with outcomes $g(\alpha,u)$, and the $k$ polynomials are
   169	recovered from $g$ because $g$ is exactly linear in $\alpha$ with high
   170	probability, by the Schwartz--Zippel lemma; applied at degree $d + 1$, that
   171	lemma contributes the term $(d+1)/q$ twice in the recovery.  The
   172	simultaneity of the $k$ outputs is thus inherited from the joint answers of
   173	the original provers through a single application of the $k = 1$ theorem.
   174	
   175	\section{The counterexample}
   176	
   177	Let $q = 2^s$, let $d = 1$, and let $\Gamma$ be the set of univariate
   178	polynomials $g = g_0 + g_1 x$ over $\F_q$, so $|\Gamma| = N = q^2$.  Two
   179	distinct elements of $\Gamma$ agree at a uniformly random point of $\F_q$
   180	with probability at most $1/q$.  Bob's Hilbert space is $\C^{\Gamma}$ with
   181	standard basis $\{\ket{g}\}$; Alice's is a second copy, and the state is
   182	the maximally entangled state
   183	$\ket{\psi} = N^{-1/2} \sum_{g \in \Gamma} \ket{g}\ket{g}$, for which
   184	$(X \ot I)\ket{\psi} = (I \ot X^{\mathsf T})\ket{\psi}$ and
   185	$\bra{\psi} X \ot Y \ket{\psi} = N^{-1}\tr(X Y^{\mathsf T})$.
   186	
   187	Equip $\Gamma \cong \F_q^2$ with the symmetric pairing
   188	$\langle h, g\rangle = h_0 g_1 + h_1 g_0$ and the additive character
   189	$\chi(t) = (-1)^{\mathrm{tr}(t)}$, where $\mathrm{tr}$ is the absolute
   190	trace of $\F_q$; the pairing is nondegenerate, so
   191	$\phi_h = N^{-1/2} \sum_{g} \chi(\langle h, g\rangle)\ket{g}$, $h \in \Gamma$,
   192	is an orthonormal basis.  Evaluation at $u \in \F_q$ is represented by the
   193	vector $v_u = u + x$, since $\langle h, v_u\rangle = h_0 + h_1 u = h(u)$, and
   194	$\langle v_u, v_u\rangle = 2u = 0$ in characteristic two.  Bob's two
   195	coordinate measurements are
   196	\[
   197	  G^{1}_h = \ket{\phi_h}\bra{\phi_h},
   198	  \qquad
   199	  G^{2}_g = \ket{g}\bra{g},
   200	  \qquad
   201	  Q^{1,u}_{[a]} = \sum_{h(u) = a} G^1_h,
   202	  \qquad
   203	  Q^{2,u}_{[b]} = \sum_{g(u) = b} G^2_g .
   204	\]
   205	Writing $H_u = \{h : h(u) = 0\} = \F_q v_u$ and summing the character over
   206	the coset $\{h : h(u) = a\}$ gives the matrix elements
   207	\[
   208	  \bra{g'} Q^{1,u}_{[a]} \ket{g}
   209	    = \frac1N \sum_{h(u) = a} \chi(\langle h, g - g'\rangle)
   210	    = \frac{1}{q}\, \chi(\langle h_a, g - g'\rangle)\,
   211	      \mathbf 1[\,g(u) = g'(u)\,],
   212	\]
   213	where $h_a$ is any polynomial with $h_a(u) = a$: the sum over
   214	$H_u = \F_q v_u$ vanishes unless $\langle v_u, g - g'\rangle = 0$, that is,
   215	unless $g(u) = g'(u)$, because $v_u$ is isotropic.  Hence $Q^{1,u}_{[a]}$
   216	is block diagonal for the partition of $\Gamma$ by the value at $u$, it
   217	commutes with every $Q^{2,u}_{[b]}$, its diagonal entries all equal $1/q$,
   218	and each product $\Pi^u_{a,b} = Q^{1,u}_{[a]} Q^{2,u}_{[b]}$ is the rank-one
   219	projector onto the unit vector
   220	$\xi^u_{a,b} = q^{-1/2} \sum_{g(u) = b} \chi(\langle h_a, g\rangle)\ket{g}$.
   221	
   222	Let both players answer the point question $u$ with the joint projective
   223	measurement $\{\Pi^u_{a,b}\}_{a,b}$, which is real symmetric, and let Alice's
   224	coordinate polynomial measurements be the transposes $(G^{i})^{\mathsf T}$.
   225	On $\ket{\psi}$ every relation of the coordinate form holds with error
   226	$0$: the marginals of the joint point measurement are $Q^{1,u}_{[a]}$ and
   227	$Q^{2,u}_{[b]}$, which are exactly the evaluated coordinate measurements, and
   228	$(G^i)^{\mathsf T} \ot I$ agrees with $I \ot G^i$ on $\ket{\psi}$.  The
   229	collision probability is $1/q$.  The sandwich on Bob's side, evaluated at
   230	$u$, is
   231	\[
   232	  C^{\mathrm B}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = (a,b)]}
   233	    = \sum_{g(u) = b} \ket{g}\bra{g}\, Q^{1,u}_{[a]}\, \ket{g}\bra{g}
   234	    = \frac1q\, Q^{2,u}_{[b]},
   235	\]
   236	and its consistency with the joint point measurement is
   237	\[
   238	  \sum_{a,b} \bra{\psi} \Pi^u_{a,b} \ot C^{\mathrm B}_{[\mathrm{eval}_u(\cdot) = (a,b)]}
   239	    \ket{\psi}
   240	    = \frac{1}{qN} \sum_{a,b} \tr\bigl(Q^{1,u}_{[a]} Q^{2,u}_{[b]}\bigr)

     3	/-!
     4	# Ground-slice compression of measurements
     5	
     6	This module restricts a POVM on a product space to one distinguished ancillary
     7	coordinate. It also records that this restriction commutes with deterministic
     8	outcome postprocessing, recovers a POVM from its one-measurement Naimark
     9	dilation, and preserves consistency defects evaluated on the correspondingly
    10	padded bipartite state.
    11	
    12	The construction supports the pullback after the first paragraph of the proof
    13	of paper `lem:qld-4-7`,
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1289`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement
    20	
    21	/-- Restrict every effect of a POVM to the matrix block at one fixed ancillary
    22	coordinate. The principal submatrix of a positive semidefinite effect remains
    23	positive semidefinite, and restricting the sum of the effects restricts the
    24	identity to the identity. -/
    25	noncomputable def compressAt
    26	    {Outcome I κ : Type*}
    27	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    28	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    29	    (k₀ : κ) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (I × κ)) :
    30	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome I :=
    31	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    32	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    33	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    34	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀))))
    35	    (by
    36	      classical
    37	      ext i j
    38	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply,

    40	        using congrFun (congrFun M.sum_eq_one (i, k₀)) (j, k₀))
    41

    44	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    45	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]

    51	/-- Restricting a POVM to a fixed ancillary coordinate commutes with

    54	    {A B I κ : Type*}

    56	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]

    54	    Real.rpow t (1 / 4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt t) := by
    55	  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul ht]
    56	  norm_num
    57	
    58	/-- Jensen's inequality for the concave function `t ↦ t^{1/4}` on a
    59	sub-probability average, obtained by applying the square-root inequality
    60	twice. -/
    61	theorem avgOver_rpow_quarter_le {X : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution X)
    62	    (h𝒟 : ∑ x ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight x ≤ 1) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) :
    63	    avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.rpow (b x) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤
    64	      Real.rpow (avgOver 𝒟 b) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    65	  have h1 : |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x)))| ≤
    66	      Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))) :=
    67	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟 _ _
    68	      (fun x => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)])
    69	      (fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h𝒟
    70	  have h2 : |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))| ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 b) :=
    71	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.avgOver_abs_le_sqrt_of_pointwise 𝒟 _ _
    72	      (fun x => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]) hb h𝒟
    73	  have havg : 0 ≤ avgOver 𝒟 b := avgOver_nonneg 𝒟 b hb
    74	  rw [rpow_quarter_eq_sqrt_sqrt havg]
    75	  calc avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.rpow (b x) (1 / 4 : ℝ))
    76	      = avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x))) :=
    77	        avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun x => rpow_quarter_eq_sqrt_sqrt (hb x)
    78	    _ ≤ |avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (b x)))| := le_abs_self _
    79	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 (fun x => Real.sqrt (b x))) := h1
    80	    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (avgOver 𝒟 b)) :=
    81	        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_trans (le_abs_self _) h2)

   145	/-- The consistency defect of two placed POVMs, read in the bipartite picture
   146	of the reindexed expanded state, is their off-diagonal mass in the expanded
   147	state. -/
   148	theorem consistencyDefect_reindex_eq {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   149	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   150	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   151	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   152	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   153	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   154	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   155	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   156	    (he₂ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side),
   157	      reindexOp e (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   158	        (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) =
   159	          S.place p₂ O)
   160	    (Q : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   161	    (R : Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side)) :
   162	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   163	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (Q.effect a) 1)
   164	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1
   165	          ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P) R).effect a))
   166	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   167	      ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α, if a = b then 0 else
   168	        stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place p₁ (Q.effect a) * S.place p₂ (R.effect b)) := by
   169	  classical
   170	  unfold consistencyDefect
   171	  rw [avgOver_uniform_const]
   172	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   173	  by_cases hab : a = b
   174	  · simp [hab]
   175	  · rw [if_neg hab, if_neg hab, consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
   176	      WinImplications.stateQForm_reindexState, WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, he₁]
   177	    change stateQForm S.psiHat (S.place p₁ (Q.effect a) *
   178	      reindexOp e (heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (R.effect b) 1))) = _
   179	    rw [he₂]

   181	set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
   182	/-- The state-dependent distance of two families placed on the first factor,
   183	read in the bipartite picture, is their placed distance in the expanded
   184	state. -/
   185	theorem opFamilyDistSq_reindex_left_eq {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
   186	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   187	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   188	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   189	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   190	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   191	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   192	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   193	    (A B : α → Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side)) :
   194	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   195	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (A a) 1) (fun _ a => heteroKron (B a) 1)
   196	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) =
   197	      ∑ a : α, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.place p₁ (A a) - S.place p₁ (B a))
   198	        S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 := by
   199	  classical
   200	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   201	  rw [avgOver_uniform_const]
   202	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   203	  rw [WinImplications.norm_applyOperatorToState_reindexState,
   204	    WinImplications.reindexOp_sub, he₁, he₁]

   206	set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
   207	/-- Fiberwise orthonormalization of the sandwich POVM: for the placement pair
   208	exhibited by the bipartition `e`, there is, for every point pair, a projective
   209	measurement on the local space of the first placement whose placed distance to
   210	the placed sandwich is at most `220` times the fourth root of the consistency
   211	bound; on average over the point pair the distance is at most `220` times the
   212	fourth root of the averaged bound.  This is the application of `lem:ortho` in
   213	the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`, paper
   214	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:786-790`,
   215	carried out for each point pair and averaged by Jensen's inequality. -/
   216	theorem exists_projective_close_sandwich (hopp : p₁.IsOpposite p₂)
   217	    (e : SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB ≃
   218	      S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side ×
   219	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side × (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))
   220	    (he₁ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   221	      reindexOp e (heteroKron O
   222	        (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side ×
   223	          (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) = S.place p₁ O)
   224	    (he₂ : ∀ O : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₂.side),
   225	      reindexOp e (heteroKron (1 : Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side))
   226	        (heteroKron O (1 : Op (PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)))) =
   227	          S.place p₂ O)
   228	    :
   229	    ∃ Q : PointPair P →
   230	        Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   231	      (∀ xz, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (Q xz)) ∧
   232	        opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   233	          (fun xz (ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) =>
   234	            S.place p₁ ((Q xz).effect ab))
   235	          (fun xz ab => S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   236	          S.psiHat ≤
   237	          220 * Real.rpow (avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P))
   238	            (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂)) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   239	  classical
   240	  have hψ : ‖reindexState e S.psiHat‖ = 1 := by
   241	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, psiHat_norm]
   242	  have hxz : ∀ xz : PointPair P,
   243	      ∃ Pm : Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P)
   244	        (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p₁.side),
   245	        MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective Pm ∧
   246	          ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   247	            (S.place p₁ (Pm.effect ab) -
   248	              S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   249	            S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 ≤
   250	            220 * Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
   251	    intro xz
   252	    have hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   253	        (fun _ ab => heteroKron ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab) 1)
   254	        (fun _ ab => heteroKron 1
   255	          ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)
   256	            (S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2)).effect ab))
   257	        (reindexState e S.psiHat) ≤ S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz := by
   258	      rw [consistencyDefect_reindex_eq S p₁ p₂ e he₁ he₂]
   259	      exact S.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ hopp xz
   260	    obtain ⟨Pm, hPm, hdist⟩ := projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant
   261	      (reindexState e S.psiHat) hψ (S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2)
   262	      (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := PauliRegister P × PauliRegister P)
   263	        (S.sandwichPoint p₂.side xz.1 xz.2))
   264	      (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (S.sandwichDefectBound_nonneg p₁ p₂ xz) hcons
   265	    refine ⟨Pm, hPm, ?_⟩
   266	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_reindex_left_eq S p₁ p₂ e he₁] at hdist
   267	    exact hdist
   268	  choose Q hQ using hxz
   269	  refine ⟨Q, fun xz => (hQ xz).1, ?_⟩
   270	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   271	  calc avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   272	        ∑ ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P, ‖applyOperatorToState
   273	          (S.place p₁ ((Q xz).effect ab) -
   274	            S.place p₁ ((S.sandwichPoint p₁.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
   275	          S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)
   276	      ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   277	          220 * Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
   278	        avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun xz => (hQ xz).2
   279	    _ = 220 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (PointPair P)) (fun xz =>
   280	          Real.rpow (S.sandwichDefectBound p₁ p₂ xz) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) :=

   161	/-- The real quadratic form of an operator evaluated on a finite vector. This
   162	is the Born expression averaged by blueprint
   163	`def:tensor-product-value`, paper origin
   164	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/
   165	def vectorQForm {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   166	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) (A : Op I) : ℝ :=
   167	  (inner ℂ ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A ψ)).re
   168	
   169	/-- Embed a bipartite state into one distinguished coordinate of each local
   170	ancilla space, extending it by zero elsewhere. This is the zero padding used by
   171	the dilations of blueprint
   172	`def:projective-strategy-general`, and of blueprint
   173	`lem:projective-strategy-setup`, paper
   174	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:155-172`. -/
   175	def padState
   176	    {I J κA κB : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   177	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   178	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   179	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   180	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((I × κA) × (J × κB)) :=
   181	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((I × κA) × (J × κB)) ℂ).symm
   182	    (fun p => if p.1.2 = aA then
   183	      if p.2.2 = bB then ψ.ofLp (p.1.1, p.2.1) else 0 else 0)
   184	
   185	/-- Padding a state at the two distinguished ancilla coordinates preserves its
   186	norm. -/
   187	theorem padState_norm
   188	    {I J κA κB : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   189	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   190	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   191	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) :
   192	    ‖padState aA bB ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   193	  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
   194	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   195	  simp only [padState, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   196	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   197	  intro i _
   198	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single aA]
   199	  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   200	    intro j _
   201	    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single bB]
   202	    · simp
   203	    · intro b _ hb
   204	      simp [hb]
   205	    · intro h
   206	      exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
   207	  · intro a _ ha
   208	    simp [ha]
   209	  · intro h
   210	    exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
   211	
   212	/-- The quadratic form of a padded state depends only on the compression of
   213	each local operator at the distinguished ancilla coordinate. -/
   214	theorem stateQForm_padState
   215	    {I J κA κB : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   216	    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   217	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   218	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   219	    (A : Op I) (B : Op J) (A' : Op (I × κA)) (B' : Op (J × κB))
   220	    (hA : ∀ i j, A' (i, aA) (j, aA) = A i j)
   221	    (hB : ∀ i j, B' (i, bB) (j, bB) = B i j) :
   222	    vectorQForm (padState aA bB ψ) (heteroKron A' B') =
   223	      vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron A B) := by
   224	  unfold vectorQForm
   225	  apply congrArg Complex.re
   226	  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct,
   227	    EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   228	  change (∑ p : (I × κA) × (J × κB),
   229	      (∑ q : (I × κA) × (J × κB),
   230	        heteroKron A' B' p q * (padState aA bB ψ).ofLp q) *
   231	        star (padState aA bB ψ).ofLp p) =
   232	    (∑ p : I × J,
   233	      (∑ q : I × J, heteroKron A B p q * ψ.ofLp q) * star ψ.ofLp p)
   234	  suffices hExpanded :
   235	      (∑ i : I, ∑ a : κA, ∑ j : J, ∑ b : κB,
   236	        (∑ k : I, ∑ l : J,
   237	          A' (i, a) (k, aA) * B' (j, b) (l, bB) * ψ.ofLp (k, l)) *
   238	            star (if a = aA then if b = bB then ψ.ofLp (i, j) else 0 else 0)) =
   239	        ∑ i : I, ∑ j : J,
   240	          (∑ k : I, ∑ l : J, A i k * B j l * ψ.ofLp (k, l)) *
   241	            star (ψ.ofLp (i, j)) by
   242	    simpa [padState, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   243	      Fintype.sum_prod_type] using hExpanded
   244	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   245	  intro i _
   246	  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single aA]
   247	  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   248	    intro j _
   249	    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single bB]
   250	    · simp_rw [hA, hB]
   251	      simp
   252	    · intro b _ hb
   253	      simp [hb]
   254	    · intro h
   255	      exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
   256	  · intro a _ ha
   257	    simp [ha]
   258	  · intro h
   259	    exact (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim

   261	/-- Choose the one-measurement Naimark dilation data for a POVM. -/
   262	def oneMeasData
   263	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   264	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   265	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) : OneMeasNaimarkData α I :=
   266	  Classical.choose (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   267	
   268	/-- The source submeasurement of the chosen Naimark data is the original POVM. -/
   269	theorem oneMeasData_source_effect
   270	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   271	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   272	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   273	    (oneMeasData M).source.effect = M.effect := by
   274	  exact congrArg MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement.effect
   275	    (Classical.choose_spec (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement))
   276	
   277	/-- Complete the Naimark projectors at one outcome to obtain a projective POVM. -/
   278	def dilatedMeasurement
   279	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   280	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   281	    (a₀ : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   282	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (I × Option α) :=
   283	  let P := completeAtOutcomeProj (oneMeasData M).toProjSubMeas a₀
   284	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne P.outcome P.outcome_pos <| by
   285	    rw [P.sum_eq_total, P.total_eq_one]
   286	
   287	/-- Every effect of the completed Naimark measurement is a projection. -/
   288	theorem dilatedMeasurement_isProjective
   289	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   290	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   291	    (a₀ : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) :
   292	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M) := by
   293	  intro a
   294	  let P := completeAtOutcomeProj (oneMeasData M).toProjSubMeas a₀
   295	  change IsProj (P.outcome a)
   296	  exact
   297	    { isIdempotentElem := P.proj a
   298	      isSelfAdjoint :=
   299	        (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (P.outcome_pos a)).isHermitian.eq }

   301	/-- Compressing a completed Naimark effect to the distinguished ancilla
   302	coordinate recovers the original POVM effect. -/
   303	theorem dilatedMeasurement_compression
   304	    {α I : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   305	    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
   306	    (a₀ a : α) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) (i j : I) :
   307	    (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M).effect a (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect a i j := by
   308	  let D := oneMeasData M
   309	  let P := D.toProjSubMeas
   310	  have hcompress (b : α) : P.outcome b (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect b i j := by
   311	    change D.liftedEffect (some b) (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect b i j
   312	    rw [D.compression_none_none]
   313	    exact congrArg (fun X : Op I => X i j)
   314	      (congrFun (oneMeasData_source_effect M) b)
   315	  have htotal : P.total (i, none) (j, none) = (1 : Op I) i j := by
   316	    rw [← P.sum_eq_total]
   317	    simp_rw [Matrix.sum_apply, hcompress]
   318	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrArg (fun X : Op I => X i j) M.sum_eq_one
   319	  simp only [dilatedMeasurement, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne]
   320	  change ((completeAtOutcomeProj P a₀).toMeasurement).outcome a
   321	      (i, none) (j, none) = M.effect a i j
   322	  rw [completeAtOutcomeProj_toMeasurement]
   323	  simp only [completeAtOutcome]
   324	  by_cases ha : a = a₀
   325	  · subst a
   326	    rw [dif_pos rfl]
   327	    rw [Matrix.add_apply, hcompress, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, htotal]
   328	    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, Matrix.one_apply]
   329	  · rw [dif_neg ha]
   330	    exact hcompress a

   336	  classical
   337	  by_contra hI
   338	  haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hI
   339	  have hzero : ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   340	  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hψ
   341	  norm_num at hψ

   343	/-- A POVM on a nonzero finite-dimensional space has an outcome. -/

   345	    {α I : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Nonempty I]
   346	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α I) : Nonempty α := by
   347	  classical
   348	  by_contra hα
   349	  haveI : IsEmpty α := not_nonempty_iff.mp hα
   350	  let i : I := Classical.choice inferInstance

   352	  simp [Matrix.sum_apply] at heq

   354	/-- Replace both local measurement families of a strategy by families on the
   355	enlarged local registers and pad the state at the distinguished ancilla
   356	coordinates. This is the dilation step shared by
   357	blueprint `def:projective-strategy-general`, and
   358	blueprint
   359	`lem:projective-strategy-setup`. -/
   360	def paddedStrategy {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) {κA κB : Type}
   361	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   362	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB)
   363	    (A' : G.QuestionA → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerA (S.ιA × κA))
   364	    (B' : G.QuestionB → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerB (S.ιB × κB)) :
   365	    Strategy G where
   366	  ιA := S.ιA × κA
   367	  ιB := S.ιB × κB
   368	  ψ := padState aA bB S.ψ
   369	  ψ_norm := (padState_norm aA bB S.ψ).trans S.ψ_norm
   370	  A := A'
   371	  B := B'
   372	
   373	/-- The padded strategy is projective as soon as both enlarged families are. -/
   374	theorem paddedStrategy_isProjective {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) {κA κB : Type}
   375	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   376	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB)
   377	    (A' : G.QuestionA → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerA (S.ιA × κA))
   378	    (B' : G.QuestionB → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerB (S.ιB × κB))
   379	    (hA : ∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A' x))
   380	    (hB : ∀ y, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (B' y)) :
   381	    (paddedStrategy S aA bB A' B').IsProjective :=
   382	  ⟨fun x => hA x, fun y => hB y⟩
   383	
   384	/-- Local dilation and padding preserve every game correlation, hence the
   385	strategy value, as soon as each enlarged family compresses to the original one
   386	at the distinguished ancilla coordinate. -/
   387	theorem paddedStrategy_value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) {κA κB : Type}
   388	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   389	    (aA : κA) (bB : κB)
   390	    (A' : G.QuestionA → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerA (S.ιA × κA))
   391	    (B' : G.QuestionB → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement G.AnswerB (S.ιB × κB))
   392	    (hA : ∀ x a i j, (A' x).effect a (i, aA) (j, aA) = (S.A x).effect a i j)
   393	    (hB : ∀ y b i j, (B' y).effect b (i, bB) (j, bB) = (S.B y).effect b i j) :
   394	    (paddedStrategy S aA bB A' B').value = S.value := by
   395	  unfold Strategy.value
   396	  apply avgOver_congr
   397	  intro xy
   398	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   399	  intro a _
   400	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   401	  intro b _
   402	  by_cases hw : G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b
   403	  · simp only [hw, if_true]
   404	    exact stateQForm_padState aA bB S.ψ ((S.A xy.1).effect a)
   405	      ((S.B xy.2).effect b) ((A' xy.1).effect a) ((B' xy.2).effect b)
   406	      (hA xy.1 a) (hB xy.2 b)
   407	  · simp [hw]
   408	
   409	/-- Dilate both local POVM families of a strategy and pad its state by the two
   410	distinguished ancilla coordinates. -/
   411	private def projectiveDilation {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   412	    (a₀ : G.AnswerA) (b₀ : G.AnswerB) : Strategy G :=
   413	  paddedStrategy S (none : Option G.AnswerA) (none : Option G.AnswerB)
   414	    (fun x => dilatedMeasurement a₀ (S.A x))
   415	    (fun y => dilatedMeasurement b₀ (S.B y))

   418	private theorem projectiveDilation_isProjective {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   419	    (a₀ : G.AnswerA) (b₀ : G.AnswerB) :
   420	    (projectiveDilation S a₀ b₀).IsProjective :=

   104	    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)

   165	      | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistributionAux
+
+/-!
+# Averages over restricted finite distributions
+
+This module records a generic comparison between a nonnegative average and
+the corresponding average after conditioning on a positive-mass event.
+
+## References
+
+The estimate supports the proof-only conditioning step in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
+`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT
+
+/-- Conditioning a nonnegative finite average inflates its bound by at most
+the inverse retained mass. This is a formalization-only finite probability
+estimate used in the conditioning step of `lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper
+`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`. -/
+theorem avgOver_restrict_le_div_mass {Sample : Type*} [DecidableEq Sample]
+    (dist : Distribution Sample) (good : Sample -> Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (hpos : 0 < ∑ sample ∈ dist.support.filter good, dist.weight sample)
+    (value : Sample -> ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ sample, 0 ≤ value sample) :
+    avgOver (Distribution.restrict dist good hpos) value ≤
+      avgOver dist value /
+        (∑ sample ∈ dist.support.filter good, dist.weight sample) := by
+  have hmul :
+      (∑ sample ∈ dist.support.filter good, dist.weight sample) *
+          avgOver (Distribution.restrict dist good hpos) value =
+        ∑ sample ∈ dist.support.filter good,
+          dist.weight sample * value sample := by
+    unfold avgOver Distribution.restrict
+    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro sample hsample
+    simp only [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp hsample).2]
+    field_simp
+  apply (le_div_iff₀ hpos).mpr
+  rw [mul_comm, hmul]
+  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
+    (fun sample _ _ => mul_nonneg (dist.nonnegative sample) (hnonneg sample))
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     6	low-degree soundness route at simultaneity parameter `1`. Return the two
     7	polynomial-tuple POVMs on the original player carriers while preserving all

     3	/-!
     4	# The sandwich POVM of the expanded point measurements
     5	
     6	The first step of the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` combines the two expanded point
     7	measurements into the sandwich POVM
     8	`R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^{(Point,Z),z}_b M^{(Point,X),x}_a M^{(Point,Z),z}_b`.  The
     9	source forms it from the binary refinements; here it is formed directly with
    10	outcomes in `F_q × F_q`, which the Parseval transfer of
    11	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Commutation.lean` makes possible.  This file
    12	defines the POVM, proves that it is close to the ordered product
    13	`M^Z_b M^X_a` by the approximate commutation, and records the consistency of
    14	the ordered products across opposite register placements, which follows from
    15	the self-consistency of each factor.
    16	
    17	## Main results
    18	
    19	* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichPoint`: the sandwich POVM.
    20	* `sandwichPoint_ordered_dist_le`: closeness of the sandwich to the ordered
    21	  product on every placement, with the error of `lem:qld-comm-cons`.
    22	* `ordered_cross_dist_le`: the ordered product on one placement is close to
    23	  the reversed ordered product on the opposite placement.
    24	
    25	## References
    26	
    27	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:731-748`
    28	(the sandwich and display `eq:qld-r-2`), blueprint
    29	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:803-960` (`lem:qld-4-10`); the
    30	route is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-direct.tex`.
    31	-/

    35	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    36	
    37	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    38	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    41
